limits: This generator performs no deletion, database operation, browser operation or network request.
Counts are exact manifest entries across isolated runs, not distinct production objects or SQL row counts. Shared fixtures are counted separately for each run.
Only identifiers/types and record hashes are copied; full synthetic record content remains in each hashed source manifest.
Reset removes the isolated run; creation of fresh fixture data in a subsequent run is not evidence of retained old records.
Missing enrollment evidence is reported explicitly; rerun after the remaining tests finish.
